headline: TBR @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 4.56 at MIA 4.10, with a projected total of 8.65. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: TBR moved +0.71 runs while MIA moved +0.37, changing the projected margin by +0.34 runs. The projected total climbed +1.08, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Griffin Jax has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Junior Caminero, Yandy Díaz, Jonathan Aranda, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Oliver Dunn, Owen Caissie because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
